Feast.name: Feast
Feast.tooltip:
Cho'Gath ravenously feeds on an enemy, dealing @RDamage@ true damage to champions or @RMonsterDamage@ to minions or jungle monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains a stack, which causes him to grow in size and gain @RHealthPerStack@ max Health. Only @RMinionMaxStacks@ stacks can be gained from minions and non-epic jungle monsters.
Current minion and non-epic jungle monster stacks: @f3@/@RMinionMaxStacks@
Cho'Gath gains bonus attack and Feast cast range based upon his stacks:
@AttackRangePerStack@ Attack Range per stack (max @MaxBonusAttackRange@).
@CastRangePerStack@ Cast Range per stack (max @MaxBonusCastRange@).

VorpalSpikes.name: Vorpal Spikes
VorpalSpikes.tooltip:
Cho'Gath's next 3 Attacks launch spikes that deal @FlatDamageCalc@ plus @MaxHealthPercentCalc@ of the target's max Health magic damage and Slow by @SlowAmountPercentage@%, decaying over @SlowDuration@ seconds.
Feast stacks increase the width of the spikes and the max Health damage by @FeastStackMultiplier@% per stack.
Percent Health damage against monsters is replaced with @ModifiedMonsterCap@.
